name: autoform
description: Set up Lean repositories, build source-grounded Markdown roadmaps, prove ready nodes, supervise unattended work, and support human or agent review.

interface.shortDescription: Lean setup, roadmaps, workers, review, LSP, and REPL
interface.longDescription: AutoForm separates repository setup from source-grounded roadmap construction, keeps the plan in an Obsidian-compatible Markdown vault, supervises unattended orchestration from cron, publishes the blueprint with GitHub Pages, checks proofs through two public Lean MCP servers, and provides distinct visual human-review and rubric-driven agent-review workflows.
defaultPrompt: Set up this Lean repository with Autoform infrastructure.
Build or refine a source-grounded Autoform roadmap.
Work through ready Autoform nodes interactively or under the Linux worker.
